name: CHLORAMPHENICOL 5 MG OPHTHALMIC OINTMENT 5 GR 1 PIECE
description: Chloramphenicol 5 mg eye ointment, available in a 5 g presentation, is an antibiotic used to treat superficial eye infections, such as bacterial conjunctivitis. It works by fighting a broad spectrum of bacteria that can cause this type of infection. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
